candidates.failure_scenario: A regeneration or a hand edit sets the Excluding row's SlopeIdx to 0 (aggregate, always 48 B) or 2 (msg). validateRow (native_gas.go:271-285) only checks SizeModExpWork rows, so boot passes. A call with N excluded keys is then charged Base plus 48 bytes whatever N is, while the native decodes and subgroup-checks all N keys (bls12381.go:91-99). The ADR (pr6375_bls12381_native.md:57-58) names the excluded-bytes slope as the pricing. TestInnerHashGasMetersBothOperands (native_gas_test.go:210-235) is the existing guard of this shape for merkle.innerHash, and nothing like it names crypto/bls12381: grep -c bls12381 on native_gas_test.go and native_gas_validate_test.go returns 0 and 0.

candidates.summary: FastAggregateVerifyExcluding's doc gives membership and PoP as the caller's obligations. A realm that meets both still accepts one committee member's signature as full participation unless it derives its participant count from excluded itself
candidates.failure_scenario: A realm ports Ethereum's validate_light_client_update. It counts participants from sync_committee_bits for the 2/3 check and, as bls12381.gno:50-53 asks, verifies a Merkle proof of each relayer-supplied excluded key against the pubkeys root. A relayer that holds the key of one sync-committee member m sets every bit, passes the other 511 members (each a proven member) as excluded, and signs a forged header with sk_m alone. Aggregate minus excluded is pk_m, so the native returns true and the realm sees 512/512 participation. The reference consumer avoids this only because nonSignerKeys (allinbits/gno-realms master, gno.land/p/aib/ibc/lightclient/ethereum/v0/ethereum.gno:472-501) checks that the non-signers are exactly the unset-bit members, each proven at its own index (gindex size+i). The godoc does not state that obligation.
candidates.verify_by: read bls12381.gno:43-58 for any sentence tying excluded to the caller's participant count (expect none); Go test in package bls12381: pubkeys, aggregate, sig := committee(t, 512, msg, func(i int) bool { return i == 0 }); X_fastAggregateVerifyExcluding(aggregate, concat(pubkeys[1:]), msg, sig) returns true
candidates.evidence: bls12381.gno:50-53 'The caller MUST have verified that every key in excluded is a member of the committee behind aggregate ... and every member MUST have passed proof-of-possession verification': no count obligation. Consumer ethereum.gno:472-501: 'if bits[i/8]&(1<<(i%8)) != 0 { continue } ... isValidMerkleBranch(pubkeyLeaf(ns.Pubkey), ns.Branch, size+i, active.PubkeysHash) ... more non-signers than unset participation bits'
